outlets.discovery: No <link rel=alternate> feed tags and no 'rss' string anywhere on https://www.vrt.be/vrtnws/{nl,en,fr,de}/ (re-checked 2026-10-25). No RSS overview page: nl/rss/ and nl/algemeen/rss/ return 404, and a web search found none. The feeds use VRT's AEM selector pattern <path>.rss.articles.xml / <path>.rss.headlines.xml. This was known from the existing nl.rss.articles.xml and applied to the en/fr/de roots. Every rubriek, regio and net-binnen path was tried with every selector variant (.rss.xml, .rss.articles.xml, .rss.headlines.xml, with and without a trailing slash). All of them return HTTP 200 with a 0-byte text/html body, so there are NO per-section or per-province RSS feeds. Section and region data was found instead in the site's own Next.js data JSON (buildId from __NEXT_DATA__) and in the BFF the pages call. The news sitemap was found via robots.txt.

apis.name: Next.js data: net-binnen (latest per section or province)
apis.purpose: Per-section and per-province 'net binnen' (latest) lists. Fields: title.text; actions[0].uri (canonical article URL https://www.vrt.be/vrtnws/nl/YYYY/MM/DD/<slug>/); publication.timestamp (epoch ms); image.url (https://images.vrt.be/orig/YYYY/MM/DD/<uuid>.<ext>, plus aspectRatio and blurHash); tag.text (section name, or the MUNICIPALITY for variant 'region' items, e.g. 'Otegem', 'Ieper'); variant ('default' or 'region'); isHighlight. apis.notes: buildId changes on every site deploy. outlets.quirks:
NO per-section and NO per-province RSS exists. Every section or region path with any .rss selector returns HTTP 200 with an EMPTY body (0 bytes, text/html). Do not treat 200 as success: check that the body is non-empty and the content-type is atom. To derive sections, filter the main feed by <vrtns:nstag> (or use the net-binnen JSON API). nstag distribution in nl.rss.articles.xml on 2026-10-25 (50 entries):
- Binnenland 11
- Europa 3
- Midden-Oosten 2, Latijns-Amerika 2, Samenleving 2, Nederland 2
- 1 each: Technologie & Wetenschap, Milieu & Klimaat, Politiek, Duitsland, Weer, Verenigde Staten, Royalty, Gezondheid, Mobiliteit, Defensie, Analyse, Seksualiteit & Relaties, Amerika kiest, Verenigd Koninkrijk
- no nstag: 14 (mostly liveblogs and features)
nstag is a single free-text value (sometimes a sub-rubric such as 'Europa', sometimes a story label such as 'Amerika kiest'), so map it to groups with a lookup table. The only other category-like element is <vrtns:nslabeltag>: 'system:vrtnieuws/brands/radio-2' 18, 'system:vrtnieuws/brands/radio-1' 6, empty 26. It is a brand label, not a section. Both vrtns elements carry xmlns="" (namespace http://base.vrt.be is declared on <feed>).
Main feed size: 50 entries sorted by <updated> descending, covering about 26 hours (updated 2026-10-24T12:56Z to 2026-10-25T14:49Z). Poll every few minutes.
Liveblogs: 7 in the main feed. Their <summary> is empty, <published> stays at the original date (up to months old), <updated> moves with each post, and the title changes to the latest post. They are recognizable by '/liveblog/' in the self link. Their per-liveblog .rss.xml self links return 404 (re-verified 2026-10-25), so they cannot be followed by RSS. Use <updated> for sorting, and consider a 'LIVE' badge plus a de-prioritized summary.
<id> and the alternate link are short links (https://vrtnws.be/p.XXXX) that redirect. The canonical URL is the self link with '.rss.xml' replaced by '/' (https://www.vrt.be/vrtnws/nl/YYYY/MM/DD/<slug>/). Dedupe by <id>: headlines and articles share about 63% of their items.
Per-article full text: the self link (<article>.rss.xml) returns a 1-entry Atom feed with full <content type="html">, which could enrich a single item on demand (one request per item; not for bulk polling).
No <author>, <category> or <content> in any list feed. Titles and summaries are type="text", plain UTF-8 without HTML. Dates are UTC with milliseconds ('2026-10-25T14:49:19.000Z'). The sitemap uses local offsets.
Images: enclosure href https://images.vrt.be/vrtnws_share/YYYY/MM/DD/<uuid>.jpg. Swap the preset segment to resize; these presets are verified on the same path: orig, vrtnws_share, w1280hx, w960hx, w640hx, w480hx, width1280, width640, width320. Every entry has an enclosure.
No premium or paywall: VRT is a free public broadcaster, so premium=false always. No tracking params in links.
en/fr/de feeds carry Dutch nstag values and update slowly (en about 4 items per day on weekdays, none at weekends).
robots.txt allows User-agent * but disallows /vrtnws/ for named AI crawlers (ClaudeBot, GPTBot, etc.). The feeds are fetched by our server with a normal UA; keep the request volume polite.

outlets.name: Sporza
outlets.discovery: Not advertised: there are no feed <link> tags, no RSS page, and no 'rss' string in the sporza.be HTML or JS. The site is a React Router v7 SSR app. The feeds were found by applying VRT's AEM selector pattern. The homepage feed is https://sporza.be/nl.rss.xml (any selector after .rss gives the same result). Category feeds are https://sporza.be/nl/categorie/<path>.rss.xml for any category on the A-Z page https://sporza.be/nl/a-z/ (about 200 /nl/categorie/ paths). Every category path tested worked. Tag pages (/nl/tag/...) have no feed. Sitemaps were found via robots.txt. All streams are therefore official=false.

outlets.quirks:
Feeds are Atom (application/feed+xml, xml:lang nl) behind CloudFront with cache-control max-age=60. Some origin responses on a cache miss are slow (two fetches timed out at 20 s and succeeded on retry), so use a 30 s timeout plus one retry. The feed <title> is always 'sporza' and the feed <author> is 'sporza - Vrt', even for category feeds. The feed self link is WRONG on every feed (always https://sporza.be/nl/.rss.xml), so key streams by the requested URL, not the self link.
Max 20 entries per feed (some have 9-15). Order is EDITORIAL (the page layout), NOT chronological: hero articles come first, then a block of video items. Sort by <updated> yourself. The homepage feed covers only about 7.5 hours.
Entry fields: title (type=text), id (= canonical URL, not a short link), published, updated, summary type=text, vrtns:nstag, link rel=alternate, link rel=enclosure (image). No <author>, <category> or <content>. The content namespace is declared but never used.
Video items: in many category feeds 4-11 of 20 entries have 'video' (and often 'Sporzatips') in nstag. Their summary is usually EMPTY, which is why summary coverage drops to 'some'. Decide whether to show them (they link to the video article page).
nstag is a PIPE-SEPARATED list: sport|competition|teams|people|editor names|'video'. Example: 'voetbal|Jupiler Pro League|KRC Genk|Standard|voetbal|Joël Heymbeeck'. It contains duplicates and inconsistent case and accents (e.g. 'Formule 1|autosport|Formule 1|autosport'). Split it, dedupe case-insensitively, take the first token as the sport, and drop editor names (they are not distinguishable from player names, so do not use it as author).
Link patterns:
- articles: /nl/YYYY/MM/DD/<slug>~<numeric id>/
- match pages: /nl/matches/<sport>/<competition>/<season>/.../<slug>~<id>/ (these update in place: title, summary and updated change during and after the match)
- evergreen category landing pages: /nl/categorie/... (e.g. Olympics hubs dated 2021-2023 in andere-sporten). Filter these out.
Titles prefixed 'LIVE' or 'LIVESTREAM' are live items. The date in the URL is the original creation date and can differ from <published> (e.g. /2026/10/12/ for an item published 2026-10-25), so do not parse dates from URLs. Dates are UTC with milliseconds ('2026-10-25T14:32:45.741Z').
Dedupe across streams by <id> (= URL): parent and child categories overlap heavily (auto-motor/formule-1 60%, zaalsport/basketbal 60%, tour/wegwielrennen 60% with identical first 5 off-season).
Images: every entry has an enclosure https://images.vrt.be/width1280/YYYY/MM/DD/<uuid>.jpg (image/jpeg). The preset segment can be swapped (orig, width640, width320, w960hx, w640hx, w480hx, w1280hx, vrtnws_share).
No premium or paywall: Sporza is free (VRT public broadcaster), so premium=false always. No tracking params.
Category URL rule: any /nl/categorie/<path>/ page from https://sporza.be/nl/a-z/ (about 200 paths, including per-competition ones like voetbal/buitenland/dfb-pokal, zaalsport/basketbal/wnba, wielrennen/wegwielrennen/wk-wielrennen) has a feed at https://sporza.be/nl/categorie/<path>.rss.xml. Validate a non-empty atom body because non-categories return HTML with 200.
robots.txt disallows / for named AI crawlers (ClaudeBot, GPTBot, etc.) while allowing User-agent *. Fetch politely with a normal UA, at most once a minute (matches max-age=60).

outlets.quirks:
FORMAT (DPG Java platform, shared by hln.be and 7sur7.be): RSS 2.0 in UTF-8 with namespaces media (http://search.yahoo.com/mrss/) and dpp (https://www.dpgmedia.cloud/paidrss).
- Item fields: title, link, description (plain-text teaser, not full text), pubDate, author, guid, media:content and dpp:paid.
- pubDate is RFC 822 GMT, e.g. "Sun, 25 Oct 2026 14:15:00 GMT", sometimes with non-zero seconds. Every item has a date.
- guid is the article URL; the stable article id is the ~a<hex> suffix.
- author is a free-text byline: full names, initials ("SW", "T.D."), "Redactie", or sources such as "Tweakers".
- No <category> and no content:encoded.
- At most 30 items per feed, newest first. The channel title is "HLN:<slug>".

TAG FEEDS: any section or tag slug resolves at https://www.hln.be/<slug>/rss.xml, so the same article shows up in many feeds. The link path is the article's primary section (e.g. /nina/ items appear in lifestyle, carriere and seks-en-liefde). Dedupe on link or the ~a<hex> id.
- Unknown slugs return a 404 HTML page of about 190 KB.
- /fun/rss.xml returns 200 text/html, so check the content-type and that the root element is <rss>.

TEXT CLEANUP:
- About 4% of descriptions contain entity-escaped inline HTML (<i>, <u>, <b>) and double-escaped ampersands ("Standard &amp; Poor's", "cd&amp;v"). After XML parsing, HTML-unescape once more and strip tags.
- Zero-width spaces (U+200B) and typographic quotes occur.
- Titles start with uppercase kickers ending in a period: "LIVE." (live blogs that keep updating), "KIJK." (video), "EXCLUSIEF.", "HUIZENJACHT.", "OPROEP.", "RESTOTIP.", "LEVENSVERHAAL.".

IMAGES: media:content@url, declared type="image/jpeg", with an identical nested media:thumbnail.
- URL shape: https://images.hln.be/<base64("<hash>/dio/<imageId>/fit-width/400")>/<seo-slug>, i.e. 400 px wide.
- The URLs are SIGNED: changing the width or the slug returns 403, so the images cannot be resized and 400 px is the maximum.
- The exact feed URL returns 200 with any UA.
- Some files declared as image/jpeg are actually GIFs.

PREMIUM (HLN Plus): <dpp:paid>true</dpp:paid> marks a paywalled article; false marks a free one. Titles carry no marker.
- At check, 822 of 2138 items (38%) across the 72 reported feeds were paid.
- Fully or almost fully paid: opinie, seks-en-liefde, gezond-en-gelukkig, carriere, erfenis, sport-in-de-buurt, vastgoed, nina, mode-en-beauty.
- Lower paid share: home 6/30, sport 5/30, buitenland 3/30. binnenland and the municipality feeds are 40-50% paid.

WAF: HTML pages return 403 to curl (and at times to custom UAs) or redirect to the myprivacy.dpgmedia.be consent wall. RSS endpoints returned 200 for every UA tested, so never scrape HTML.

REGIONAL: there are no province feeds; provincie-*, limburg, kempen, kust, waasland and the like all return 404.
- Regional news is per municipality: https://www.hln.be/<gemeente>/rss.xml, 30 fresh items that include neighbouring municipalities (hasselt includes genk).
- Slugs: about 296, listed at https://www.hln.be/regio/wijzigen/ as /regio/<slug>/select-regio. Merged municipalities use merged slugs (beveren-kruibeke-zwijndrecht, bilzen-hoeselt).
- /regio/<gemeente>/rss.xml returns a 301 to /<gemeente>/rss.xml.
- Antwerp districts (berchem, borgerhout) return the antwerpen feed.
- Also verified working: kortrijk, mechelen, aalst, middelkerke, beveren-kruibeke-zwijndrecht.
- Reported province proxies: Antwerpen = antwerpen, Oost-Vlaanderen = gent, West-Vlaanderen = brugge, Limburg = hasselt, Vlaams-Brabant = leuven, plus brussel.

outlets.quirks:
Same Next.js platform and feed format as De Morgen ("RSS for Node", RSS 2.0, UTF-8, channel titles "Humo: <name>").
- Item fields: title in CDATA, link, guid isPermaLink=false (a short hex string equal to the ~b<hex> id in the URL), pubDate (RFC 822 GMT, every item dated), and media:content plus media:thumbnail.
- There is no description, author, categories, full content or paid flag, so plan a title + image card.

PREMIUM: paywalled Humo articles are not marked in the feed. Only the article JSON-LD isAccessibleForFree shows it, and article HTML sits behind the DPG WAF and consent wall, so it is not usable.

ORDERING: the homepage feed (61 items) is in homepage order, not chronological, with items going back months; sort by pubDate. Section feeds are long (30-58 items) and slow-moving for a weekly magazine, with tails reaching into 2025 (tv, muziek). Filter by age.

IMAGES: https://image.humo.be/<imageId>/feature-crop/320/320/<slug>. They are resizable like De Morgen's: /feature-crop/1280/720/<slug> and /width/1200/<slug> return 200 and the slug is free text. A few items in achter-het-nieuws and muziek have no image.

outlets.quirks: Mediahuis BE platform, same format on all 4 brands. Premium: non-namespaced <premium>true|false</premium> element (no '+' in titles). Title/description CDATA plain text; no full text. pubDate GMT; atom:updated ISO. Dedupe on guid or /(\d+)\.html (slugs change). guid prefix UnitedRobots- = automated match reports (no author), filter. One <category> = section or municipality. Image enclosure@url == media:content@url; replace /alternates/BASE_SIXTEEN_NINE/ (3840px) with SIXTEEN_NINE_960 etc. Max 50 items, no ETag; poll 5-15 min. HTML/sitemaps Cloudflare 403. robots.txt TDM opt-out: show headline/teaser/image + link only. DS: ~70% premium; print items get placeholder pubDates 21:59:00 or 00:00:00 GMT (date-only; use atom:updated if different). Also OK: /nieuws/, /economie/geld/, /economie/beurs/, /natuur-en-wetenschap/, /weekend/, /inspiratie/, /opinies/columns/, /tag/topverhalen/, /tag/cultuurtips/, /video/ (+rss/). outlets.quirks: RSS 2.0, exactly 10 items per feed (no paging; ?limit/?count params ignored). Items have only title, one <category> (section label such as 'Ondernemen', 'Politiek & Economie', 'Markten Live', 'Netto', 'Sabato', 'Opinie', 'Dossiers'), link, plain-text <description> teaser (no HTML), pubDate (RFC 822, GMT) and guid. No images, no author, no content:encoded at all, so an image must come from elsewhere (og:image of the article page is behind Akamai bot detection and was not fetched) or the UI must render text-only cards. link and guid are the same redirect URL https://www.tijd.be/r/t/1/id/<numericArticleId>; the redirect itself returns 403 to curl (Akamai), browsers follow it to the canonical article URL. Use the numeric id as dedupe key: the same article appears in the parent feed and its sub-feeds (e.g. politiek + politiek_europa) and in nieuws. Titles/descriptions contain XML entities (', &) and typographic quotes; decode once. Channel title is 'De Tijd <Section>' and channel <link> points to the feed itself. Cache-Control max-age=140, so polling every 2-5 minutes is enough. PREMIUM: the feed carries no paywall marker of any kind. Most articles are subscriber-only (reportedly flagged isAccessibleForFree:false in the article JSON-LD; not verified here because article pages return 403 to server-side fetches); the client should treat every item as possibly paywalled (e.g. show a generic lock or no marker) rather than claim free/paid per item. Bot protection: the HTML site, the /rss overview page and api.mediafin.be return 403 to server-side fetches; only the /rss/*.xml endpoints respond 200. Fetch with a normal browser User-Agent and modest frequency.

Items have only title, one <category> (section label such as 'Entreprises', 'Economie & Politique', 'Les marchés', 'Mon Argent', 'Sabato', 'Opinions', 'Culture', 'Dossiers'), link, plain-text <description> teaser (no HTML), pubDate (RFC 822, GMT) and guid. Use the numeric id as dedupe key: the same article appears in the parent feed and its sub-feeds (e.g. politique + politique_belgique, entreprises + entreprises_banques) and in actualite. Titles/descriptions contain XML entities (', &) and typographic quotes; decode once. Channel title is 'L'Echo <Section>' and channel <link> points to the feed itself. Cache-Control max-age=140, so polling every 2-5 minutes is enough. PREMIUM: the feed carries no paywall marker of any kind. Most articles are subscriber-only (reportedly flagged isAccessibleForFree:false in the article JSON-LD; not verified here because article pages return 403 to server-side fetches); the client should treat every item as possibly paywalled (e.g. show a generic lock or no marker) rather than claim free/paid per item. Bot protection: the HTML site, the /rss overview page and api.mediafin.be return 403 to server-side fetches; only the /rss/*.xml endpoints respond 200. Fetch with a normal browser User-Agent and modest frequency. L'Echo specifics: the server intermittently stalls (requests hang until timeout), so use a 30 s timeout with one retry. Channel title of entreprises.xml is "L'Echo Entreprendre". Text is French with typographic apostrophes and ' entities.

outlets.quirks:
WordPress 7.1.3 RSS 2.0 (namespaces content, dc, atom, sy, slash) behind CloudFront + AWS WAF. 50 items per section feed (sub-sites focus/weekend: 10). Each item: title, link (canonical permalink, no tracking params), dc:creator (CDATA), pubDate (RFC 822, +0000), one or more (CDATA; first one is not necessarily the section and can be internal tags), guid isPermaLink=false https:///?p=, description (CDATA HTML:

teaser

followed by a boilerplate '

The post title appeared first on Knack.

' paragraph that must be stripped; teaser may contain inline ), and . No content:encoded (no full text). Titles use numeric entities (‘ ’ – …); decode HTML entities. Images: enclosure URLs follow https://img.static-rmg.be/a/view/q75/w680/h0/[f,/]/.jpg; w680 is the requested width (h0 = keep ratio) and f, is a focal point in percent, so larger renditions for a wallpaper can be requested by changing the w segment and the focal point can drive cropping. IDs: use guid only when it is https:///?p=; a few items have an empty , a guid on a staging host (staging.levif.be, staging-trends.knack.be, staging-sportmagazine.knack.be) or a permalink-style guid, so fall back to the link. The same post appears in /feed/ and in all its category feeds, dedupe by post id/link. Live blogs keep an old post id but get a bumped pubDate. Conditional GET works (If-Modified-Since -> 304), but Last-Modified/ETag are site-wide, so a 200 does not mean that particular section changed. sy:updatePeriod hourly. robots.txt contains 'Disallow: */feed/', so poll politely (e.g. every 10-15 min) and identify the app. PREMIUM: the feed has no paywall marker (no category, flag or prefix). Paid articles are only marked in the article HTML (c-premium-indicator lock icon, dl_art_paywall / dl_art_pluscontent dataLayer fields), and all HTML is behind the AWS WAF '405 Human Verification' challenge, so premium status cannot be determined server-side without circumventing bot protection; treat it as unknown. WAF: the homepage, section HTML pages, /wp-json/ REST API and sitemaps return 405 text/html 'Human Verification' to curl; only /feed/ URLs are served. Section feeds are not advertised anywhere (official=false) but are the standard WordPress category feed pattern and validated live. Knack specifics: category 'RoulartaCares' and similar internal tags appear. Knack Plus (paywalled) and free articles are mixed in every feed with no way to tell them apart from RSS.

WordPress 7.1.3 RSS 2.0 (namespaces content, dc, atom, sy, slash) behind CloudFront + AWS WAF. 50 items per section feed (sub-sites focus/weekend: 10). Each item: title, link (canonical permalink, no tracking params), dc:creator (CDATA), pubDate (RFC 822, +0000), one or more (CDATA; first one is not necessarily the section and can be internal tags), guid isPermaLink=false https:///?p=, description (CDATA HTML:

teaser

followed by a boilerplate '

The post title appeared first on Le Vif.

' paragraph that must be stripped; teaser may contain inline ), and . No content:encoded (no full text). Titles use numeric entities (‘ ’ – …); decode HTML entities. Images: enclosure URLs follow https://img.static-rmg.be/a/view/q75/w680/h0/[f,/]/.jpg; w680 is the requested width (h0 = keep ratio) and f, is a focal point in percent, so larger renditions for a wallpaper can be requested by changing the w segment and the focal point can drive cropping. IDs: use guid only when it is https:///?p=; a few items have an empty , a guid on a staging host (staging.levif.be, staging-trends.knack.be, staging-sportmagazine.knack.be) or a permalink-style guid, so fall back to the link. The same post appears in /feed/ and in all its category feeds, dedupe by post id/link. Live blogs keep an old post id but get a bumped pubDate. Conditional GET works (If-Modified-Since -> 304), but Last-Modified/ETag are site-wide, so a 200 does not mean that particular section changed. sy:updatePeriod hourly. robots.txt contains 'Disallow: */feed/', so poll politely (e.g. every 10-15 min) and identify the app. PREMIUM: the feed has no paywall marker (no category, flag or prefix). Paid articles are only marked in the article HTML (c-premium-indicator lock icon, dl_art_paywall / dl_art_pluscontent dataLayer fields), and all HTML is behind the AWS WAF '405 Human Verification' challenge, so premium status cannot be determined server-side without circumventing bot protection; treat it as unknown. WAF: the homepage, section HTML pages, /wp-json/ REST API and sitemaps return 405 text/html 'Human Verification' to curl; only /feed/ URLs are served. Section feeds are not advertised anywhere (official=false) but are the standard WordPress category feed pattern and validated live. Le Vif specifics: channel language fr-BE; section channel titles look like 'Politique: toute l'actualité - Le Vif'. The /belgique/feed/ stream is configured differently from every other Le Vif feed: 39 items, no images, plain-text CDATA description without the 'The post' footer, and about 6 of 39 items are filed outside /belgique/ (France, economy); confirmed on two fetches. Le Vif Plus (paywalled) items are not marked in RSS.

Only rtbfinfo_homepage (10 items) is newest-first and has atom:updated. DATES: RFC-822 with +0100/+0200 offsets (Europe/Brussels). Template: https://static-content.rtbf.be/article/image/{WxH}/a/b/c/<hash>.jpg; 770x433 can be swapped for 180x100, 370x208, 1248x702 or 1920x1080. SUMMARY: plain-text CDATA, truncated with '...'. It is unreliable, so use the stream topics instead. ENTITIES: some titles are double-escaped (&amp;, &#039;), so decode twice. Channel titles start with ' - ' (e.g. ' - Info'). atom:link self is malformed (https://article/rss/...). GUID is the permalink. The article ID is the trailing -(\d+)$ in the URL. Dedupe on that ID across the ~95 overlapping feeds, because one story appears in many. LIVE: there is no liveblog feed. Live coverage is a normal article titled 'Direct ...' or 'En direct'. Its title and URL slug change while the trailing ID stays the same, so upsert by ID. The server sometimes takes more than 20s or returns a 302 before succeeding, so retry. No per-municipality feeds; regional granularity stops at province level.

outlets.quirks: Free site with no paywall, so premium is false. DATE: pubDate is non-RFC, e.g. 'Sun, 10/25/2026 - 14:58'. That is M/D/Y HH:MM in Europe/Brussels local time with no offset, so parse it with a regex and apply the Europe/Brussels zone (DST-aware). Items are sorted newest-first, 10 per feed. CHANNEL: the title is always 'Actualité' and the description/link hold 'Not set, please configure' placeholders, so use the catalog names. TITLE and DESCRIPTION are CDATA plain text with typographic quotes. Video items have no description. AUTHOR: dc:creator is wrapped in literal double quotes ("\"Gaëtan Willemsen\""), so strip them. It can be an agency (Belga) or missing. A bogus duplicate <dc-creator> element is also present; ignore it. CATEGORY: one CDATA category holding the section label (e.g. Economie, Vidéos). IMAGE: media:content@url (style ena_16_9_extra_big) with a nested media:thumbnail@url (ena_16_9_medium). URL template: https://rtleng.rosselcdn.net/sites/default/files/dpistyles_v2/<style>/YYYY/MM/DD/node_<id>/<fid>/public/...jpeg. The style can be swapped (ena_16_9_medium, rtl_16_9_387w/505w/749w/917w) and ?itok can be dropped; all of these returned 200. GUID '804502 at www.rtl.be' is not a URL, so use link. The node ID is the trailing /article/<id> or /video/<id>. Dedupe on it across overlapping parent and child sections (e.g. sport > football > football-belgique). Links carry no tracking params. TRANSIENT 404s: the server sometimes returns 404 for valid feeds (seen on 154, 29 and 40), so retry before marking a feed dead. The /rss/<id>/cible_principale variant is invalid XML (unbound media prefix); use /rss2/. Regional granularity stops at province level; no per-municipality feeds.

outlets.quirks:
Format: WordPress RSS2 with exactly 10 items per feed. Use the guid (https://api.brusselstimes.com/?p=<id>, isPermaLink=false) or the numeric id in the link as the stable key. Links already point to www: https://www.brusselstimes.com/<category>/<id>/<slug>/. The same post appears in several category feeds, so dedupe by id.

Dates: pubDate is RFC-822 with +0000 and is true UTC. apiv2 'published' has no offset but is also UTC (same 15:03:36 for id 2377654 in both).

Text: titles contain numeric HTML entities (’ –), so decode them. description is a plain-text excerpt in CDATA ending in ' […]'; strip that tail. content:encoded is absent, so there is no full text. dc:creator is the byline, often 'The Brussels Times with Belga' or 'The Brussels Times'.

Categories: they include layout and housekeeping labels ('side', 'All News', 'Belgium News') that should be filtered out.

Premium: an item is premium when it has <category><![CDATA[premium2]]></category>, which equals apiv2 plus:true. It is rare (1 of about 200 items checked, in Magazine).

Images: none in RSS. Enrich by id from apiv2 /latest or /category (image{path,file}) as https://api.brusselstimes.com/wp-content/uploads/{path}/{file}. Files carry a WP size suffix such as -768x512 or -768x1152; strip it for the original.

Traps: an unknown /category/<slug>/feed/ silently returns the main feed, so validate by channel <title> ('<Name> – The Brussels Times'). None of these feeds is advertised by the site. apiv2 occasionally times out, so retry.

outlets.quirks:
Format: Drupal (Wieni) RSS2, 100 items per feed, newest first. guid isPermaLink=true and equals the link.

Dates: pubDate is in local time with a +0200/+0100 offset (DST switched on 2026-10-25). Some items have editorial times such as 09:00:00.

Author: <author> holds a plain name, initials ('MD') or 'BRUZZ', not RFC email. Some items have several <author> elements, so collect all of them.

Category: one <category domain="https://www.bruzz.be/topic/<slug>"> per item with the display name.

Text: description is plain text, sometimes with a trailing space, so trim it. There is no content:encoded and no full text.

Images: <enclosure url> is an http:// URL to a signed 360x270 crop: http://wmimages.bruzz.be/styles/<hash>/YYYY-MM/<file>?style=<b64>&sign=<hex>. Do not alter the signed style URL. For a larger image, drop 'styles/<hash>/' and the query to get the original, https://wmimages.bruzz.be/YYYY-MM/<file> (verified 200; it can be multi-MB, so resize server-side). Alternatively use the og:image (1200x630) from the article page. enclosure length=0 and type is always image/jpeg.

Paywall: none; BRUZZ is free. Set premium=false.

Overlap: rss.xml contains all news, and topic and municipality feeds are subsets of it, so dedupe by guid. Article paths are /actua/<topic>/<slug>-YYYY-MM-DD, /select/<topic>/..., /ice/ice/..., /videoreeks/.... The topic feeds' atom:self uses numeric ids (/topic/<id>/rss.xml); the slug form is what I verified.

Municipality feeds: https://www.bruzz.be/gemeente/{slug}/rss.xml for brussel, brussel-stad, anderlecht, elsene, etterbeek, evere, ganshoren, haren, jette, koekelberg, laken, neder-over-heembeek, oudergem, schaarbeek, sint-agatha-berchem, sint-gillis, sint-jans-molenbeek, sint-joost-ten-node, sint-lambrechts-woluwe, sint-pieters-woluwe, ukkel, vorst, watermaal-bosvoorde (all listed on the official RSS page; four verified and reported). A 'location' picker could map to these.

outlets.quirks:
Format: Drupal RSS2, 20 items per feed. <guid isPermaLink=false> is the numeric Drupal node id; use it as the key. There are no <category> elements, so derive categories from the feed (nieuws, analyse, debat) or leave them empty. <author> holds a plain name.

Dates: pubDate carries a +0200/+0100 offset. Many items are scheduled at exactly 06:00 local.

Text: some titles have leading whitespace and descriptions end with a newline; trim both.

'Opgepikt': the running news blog appears as an item whose link is https://apache.be/Opgepikt. That link is not unique and the item is updated in place, so key on guid and consider labelling it Live.

Links: https://apache.be/YYYY/MM/DD/<slug> (no www).

Images: <enclosure url> is a .webp image style (https://apache.be/sites/default/files/styles/apache_medium/public/YYYY-MM/<name>.jpg.webp?itok=...) but declares type="image/jpeg". For the original, remove 'styles/apache_medium/public/' and the '.webp?itok=...' tail to get https://apache.be/sites/default/files/YYYY-MM/<name>.jpg (verified 200).

Paywall: nothing in RSS. The article page has <article class="... apache-paywall-article apache-category-<type>"> for paywalled pieces. Of 20 items checked, 11 were paywalled: all analyse, interview, reportage and onderzoek items. nieuws and debat items were free. Cheap heuristic: premium=false for items also present in the nieuws or debat feeds, premium=true otherwise. To be exact, fetch the article HTML once per new item and test for 'apache-paywall-article'; that is a single class check, not content scraping.

Volume: low, under 2 items/day, so polling every 30-60 min is enough.

outlets.discovery: There is no RSS or Atom: no <link rel=alternate>, and every common feed path returns 404 (see rejected). sitemap.xml lists URLs without dates. The site is a Next.js app. Its overview pages (/artikels, /nieuws, /opinie, /themas/<x>, /regios/<x>) are pre-rendered, and Next.js serves their props as JSON at /_next/data/{buildId}/{path}.json. The site itself uses this endpoint for client-side navigation, and it returns the 24 newest items of the list as clean JSON. The buildId comes from the homepage's __NEXT_DATA__ (current: -RQyZiS9pX77N9rsWBXIp, re-read and unchanged on 2026-10-25). The streams below are those JSON routes (official=false). Their URLs contain the current buildId and must be rebuilt when it rotates (see apis).

apis.name: Next.js data route (article lists)
apis.purpose: Clean JSON of the 24 newest items for any MO* overview page (all articles, a type, a theme or a region). This powers all MO* streams.
apis.responseNotes: Items are at pageProps.story.content.initialArticles = {items[24], total}. Each item has uuid, created_at (Storyblok creation time, UTC), full_slug (URL = https://www.mo.be/{full_slug}), name, and content{component 'article'|'video', date 'YYYY-MM-DD 00:00' (date only, local), date_updated, title, heading_subtitle, label, preview_text, intro (TipTap/Storyblok richtext doc), author (object or array of {name,...}, or null), author_custom (richtext), category{name}, themes[{name}], regions[uuid], countries[], hero_image{filename, alt, copyright}, preview_image{filename}, time_to_read{timeToRead}, mave_video_id (video)}. Slugs: artikels, nieuws, opinie, analyse, reportage, interview, column, video, podcast, essay, blog, extra, themas/<theme>, regios/<region>.
apis.pagination: none: only the first 24 items (initialArticles.total gives the count). Deeper pages are loaded client-side through Storyblok, not this route.
apis.freshness: ISR-cached (x-nextjs-cache: HIT, cache-control: no-cache). New items appeared the same day. The URL dies (404) whenever the site redeploys and the buildId changes.
apis.notes: About 570 KB per call because it carries the whole page props. Poll every 30-60 min at most. Fallback when a call 404s: GET https://www.mo.be/, parse <script id="__NEXT_DATA__">, read .buildId, retry.

apis.name: Homepage __NEXT_DATA__ (buildId discovery)
apis.purpose: Resolve the current Next.js buildId needed by the data route.
apis.responseNotes: HTML (about 1.3 MB) containing <script id="__NEXT_DATA__" type="application/json">{...,"buildId":"-RQyZiS9pX77N9rsWBXIp",...}</script>. Only buildId is needed; no HTML scraping of articles.
apis.notes: Cache the buildId and refresh it only when the data route returns 404.

apis.name: Storyblok GraphQL (client-side CMS API)
apis.purpose: Would allow deeper pagination and per-story fetches straight from MO*'s CMS.
apis.requiredHeaders: Token header holding MO*'s Storyblok delivery token, which is embedded in their JS bundle and deliberately not reproduced here
apis.notes: Not pursued, because it relies on a CMS access token MO* never issued to us. Ask MO* (Wereldmediahuis) for permission or an official feed before using it. The Next.js data route is enough for the newest items.

outlets.quirks:
Not RSS: the adapter reads JSON from the Next.js data route. Hard-coded stream URLs contain a buildId that rotates on every deploy. Treat 404 as 'refresh buildId from the homepage __NEXT_DATA__ and retry'. Responses are large (about 570 KB) for 24 items.

Dates: content.date is date-only ('YYYY-MM-DD 00:00', Brussels local) and there is no publish timestamp. created_at is the Storyblok draft creation time, which can be earlier than publication. Sort by content.date, then created_at. date_updated is usually empty.

Author: content.author is an object, an array of objects with .name, or null. Fall back to the plain text of the author_custom richtext; guest opinion authors live there.

Summary: preview_text (plain) when present, else flatten the intro richtext (TipTap doc: content[].content[].text).

Categories: content.category.name (Nieuws, Analyse, Opinie, Reportage, Interview, Column...), content.themes[].name, and region uuids. label is usually empty.

Images: hero_image.filename is https://a.storyblok.com/f/228295/{W}x{H}/{hash}/{file}. Append '/m/600x0' (or '/m/{w}x{h}') for a resized copy via the Storyblok image service (verified). Video items have no image (mave_video_id only).

Paywall: none; MO* is free. Set premium=false.

URLs: https://www.mo.be/{full_slug}; full_slug starts with the type (nieuws/..., analyse/..., video/...). The same article appears in artikels, its type list, its theme lists and its region lists, so dedupe by uuid.

Locales: en and fr have no lists.

endpoints.name: page-content-home
endpoints.purpose: Homepage / top stories stream (editorial ranking).
endpoints.requiredHeaders: none (verified with no UA and no accept; send accept: application/json and a UA anyway)

Fields per teaser: actions[0].uri = article URL; title.text; image.url (images.vrt.be/orig/...), image.aspectRatio, image.blurHash; publication.timestamp (epoch ms, equals the article publish time); tag.text (section or town name); isHighlight; variant (default | region | analysis | liveblog-default | video); analytics.ebaContexts[].data.targetpageid (e.g. 'article-1792933950208'). mediaTeaser adds duration.seconds and links to /kijk/. Teasers have NO summary and NO author. Get those from article detail (seo.description, articleHeading.authors). No premium flag exists (public broadcaster, no paywall). About 51 KB, about 38 teasers.

Body: articleText.text.html blocks (HTML). detailMore lists tags, regions and dossiers with NAVIGATE URIs. pageProperties also has analytics (articleauthor, articlewordcount, labels), savePageId 'article-{id}', sharePermalink, caching.maxAge 10, detailType. Placeholders reference related-articles and most-read. About 20 KB.

The list embeds ALL posts: 29 for 1791111887608 and 383 for 1790599460224 (627 KB), the same as main/list. endpoints.name: liveblog-main-list
endpoints.purpose: Liveblog post stream. This is the endpoint the site polls every 60 s. Each post becomes one item.
endpoints.requiredHeaders: none (the site sends If-None-Match with the last etag)
endpoints.responseNotes: Top level is {type:'liveBlogList', variant:'live'|'end', compositions:[...]}. Compositions are liveBlogHeading, optional liveBlogSummary, optional liveBlogBanner, then liveBlogPost entries newest first, then detailMore. Heading: title.text (= newest headline), subtitle.html, image, tag{prefix:'Liveblog'|'Einde liveblog', text: topic}, icon 'PULSE' (only while live). Post: {id: base64('liveblog_item_<createdMs>'); the opening post is 'bGl2ZWJsb2dfaXRlbQ' = 'liveblog_item'; author?{text, image.url}; metadata[{type:'time', timestamp(ms), absoluteTime}]; seo.publishedOn (ISO+offset); variant? 'highlight'; compositions:[liveBlogPostTitle, liveBlogPostText{text.html}, liveBlogPostImage, liveBlogPostVideo, liveBlogPostEmbed, liveBlogPostInternalTeaser, liveBlogPostQuote, liveBlogPostAudio, liveBlogPostBanner]}. Sizes: 383 posts = 623 KB; 29 posts = about 40 KB.
endpoints.pagination: None. Every post is returned in one response, back to the opening post. No page, offset or next link.
endpoints.freshness: max-age=10, swr=30, CloudFront ETag. The client polls every 60 s (polling.interval) with If-None-Match and treats 304 as no change; polling stops when variant==='end'.
endpoints.notes: sampleFiles: /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-williamragnarsson-Documents-Programming-news-wallpaper/0caac9a3-ce23-49a0-8649-ba7ffd1030f7/scratchpad/research/feeds/vrt-api__liveblog-main-list.json (live, 383 posts) and /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-williamragnarsson-Documents-Programming-news-wallpaper/0caac9a3-ce23-49a0-8649-ba7ffd1030f7/scratchpad/research/feeds/vrt-api__liveblog-main-list-ended.json (Storm Austen, variant 'end', 110 posts, has liveBlogBanner). liveblog.discovery: There is no endpoint that lists active liveblogs. page/content for /vrtnws/nl/liveblog/, /liveblogs/, /net-binnen/liveblogs/ and /tag/liveblog/ all return 404. The HTML pageProps.liveStatus only holds the NWS-kort feed id. The most reliable method is to poll page-content-net-binnen (100 newest items) and collect every teaser with variant 'liveblog-default' or a URI matching /vrtnws/nl/liveblog/<slug>~<liveblogId>/. A liveblog teaser's publication.timestamp is the time of its newest post, and its title is that post's headline, so every update bumps it back to the top. Today net-binnen held 9 distinct liveblogs: 1791111887608, 1790599460224, 1787143375321, 1784611610051, 1792507723130, 1789060001669, 1792770744209, 1792663198457 (ended) and 1779777185712. The homepage showed 6 of them. For quieter liveblogs that drop out of the top 100, also scan the net-binnen/<section> and <province> lists, the dossier pages and search results (searchTeaser variant 'liveBlog'). Key each liveblog by the numeric id after '~', which is its creation time in ms. Then call /liveblog/liveblog-{id}/main/list. Teasers carry no live/ended flag (the ended Storm Austen liveblog still showed as liveblog-default in net-binnen), so check the status via main/list.
liveblog.pagination: /liveblog/liveblog-{id}/main/list returns every post in one response. There is no paging, no next link and no offset param. Posts are sorted newest first and the list always runs back to the opening post (id 'bGl2ZWJsb2dfaXRlbQ' = base64 'liveblog_item'). Counts measured today: 400 (1761226560191, Oct 2025 to Aug 2026, opening post included), 397, 392, 387 (ended), 383 (1790599460224, the busiest active one, 623 KB), 373, 337, 267, 110 (ended), 77, 74, 60, 29 and 12. The SSR page and page/content embed exactly the same full list (383 for 1790599460224). Older posts therefore need no extra request. The cost is payload size (up to about 690 KB), so poll with If-None-Match: the site itself polls every 60 s (polling.interval) and replaces the whole list. To get only new posts, diff by post id or metadata timestamp. Post ids are base64url('liveblog_item_<createdMs>'). A few backdated posts can sort after the opening post.
liveblog.compositionTypes: liveBlogList top level: {type, variant:'live'|'end', compositions}. Heading and summary blocks: liveBlogHeading {title.text (= current headline), subtitle.html, image{url, alt, aspectRatio}, tag{prefix 'Liveblog'|'Einde liveblog', text topic}, icon 'PULSE' only while live, authors[], actions[]}. liveBlogSummary {title.text 'Samenvatting:', html <ul> bullets, isCollapsed}. liveBlogBanner {title, image, actions[] CTA}, a call-to-action; seen on the ended storm blog. detailMore {compositions: detailMoreItem links to dossiers/tags}. liveBlogPost {id, type, author?{text, image.url}, metadata[{type:'time', timestamp ms, absoluteTime}], seo.publishedOn ISO+offset, variant? 'highlight' (196 of 3298 posts), compositions[...]}. Child types inside posts (counts across 14 liveblogs): liveBlogPostText 3402 {text.html, isEmphasised}; liveBlogPostTitle 3281 {title.text, isEmphasised}; liveBlogPostVideo 631 {action with analytics mediaid/medialength, mediaReference pbs-pub-..., image, aspectRatio e.g. 9/16}; liveBlogPostImage 525 {image{url, alt, aspectRatio, title.text caption, subtitle.text credit, isSensitiveContent}}; liveBlogPostEmbed 271 {html raw third-party embed, e.g. a twitter-tweet blockquote}; liveBlogPostInternalTeaser 196 {actions[0].uri to a VRT article, image, label.text 'Lees ook', metadata time, title}; liveBlogPostQuote 82 {title.text quote, subtitle.text speaker}; liveBlogPostAudio 37 {action with analytics mediaid/medianame, mediaReference}; liveBlogPostBanner 1 {title, image, actions[] external CTA, variant}. The JS bundle also knows liveBlogItem and liveBlogTeaserItem, and a 'qanda-list' that uses the same polling, but none were seen in data.
liveblog.statusDetection: Primary: the top-level variant of the main/list (or page/content liveBlogList) response is 'live' or 'end'. Verified 'end' on 1792663198457 (Storm Austen, last post 2026-10-24) and 1780888076260 (Midden-Oosten, last post 2026-07-20). The site's client stops polling when variant==='end'. Secondary signals: when ended, liveBlogHeading.tag.prefix changes from 'Liveblog' to 'Einde liveblog' and icon 'PULSE' disappears; seo.description/title start with 'LIVE ' while live. Caveat: editors do not always close liveblogs. Several dormant ones still report 'live', e.g. 1761226560191 (last post 2026-08-31) and 1780024580839 (last post 2026-09-28). Treat 'live' plus a newest post within about 24-48 h as active, and 'live' with an older newest post as dormant or hidden.
liveblog.notes: Liveblog item mapping: title = liveBlogPostTitle.title.text, falling back to the first sentence of the text; summary = stripped liveBlogPostText.html; published = metadata time timestamp or seo.publishedOn; author = author.text; image = first liveBlogPostImage.image.url or the video image; url = the liveblog page URL (posts have no own URL in the payload). Unchanged bodies give 304 with If-None-Match; ETags are quoted UUIDs on liveblogs and weak hashes on pages.

vrtApi.notes:
VRT NWS web BFF is https://vrtnws-web-bff.vrt.be/vrtnws-bff/web. Everything was verified today, 2026-10-25, with curl GET (accept: application/json + desktop Chrome UA). All endpoints in this catalog returned 200 with no auth, cookies or special headers. Requests also work without a UA, accept or language param. HEAD works.

Shared mechanics:
- (1) One generic endpoint, /page/content/{base64url(absolute www.vrt.be/vrtnws URL)}?language=nl, resolves any site page: home, net-binnen (+ /section/, /section/sub/, /province/), rubrieken, regio province and municipality, article, /kijk/ video, liveblog, tag, dossier, dossiers index, zoek?query=, feed, verkeer, plus the en/fr/de editions.
  - Use standard base64 of the full https URL with a trailing slash, +/ mapped to -_; padding is optional. Relative paths, or URLs that don't exist, return 404 with an empty or HAL-style error body.
- (2) Pages are a tree of {type, variant, compositions}. Walk it recursively and collect articleTeaser, mediaTeaser, numberTeaser and searchTeaser leaves.
- (3) Lower page sections load through 'next': {uri} chains, e.g. home -> headlines/best-of -> category/block/all; rubriek -> category/best-of/{b64('functional:vrtnieuws/categories/<slug>')} -> category/block/{b64}; regio -> region/province/best-of -> region/province/regions-block.
- (4) Caching: every response carries cache-control: max-age=10, stale-while-revalidate=30, stale-if-error=1800 through CloudFront, plus an ETag. If-None-Match returns 304 (verified). Poll net-binnen every 60-120 s and active liveblogs every 60 s (the site's own interval).

Normalization:
- id: analytics targetpageid (article-<ms>, liveblog-<ms>, video-<ms>), or the URL.
- title: title.text.
- url: actions[0].uri (or action.uri on searchTeaser).
- published: publication.timestamp in ms. For articles this equals the article's publishtimestamp and seo.publishedOn (verified on article-1792936286132). For liveblog teasers it is the newest post time, i.e. an 'updated' time.
- image: image.url on images.vrt.be/orig/...; aspectRatio and blurHash are included.
- category: tag.text, a section or municipality name.
- Teasers lack summary and authors. Fetch article detail for seo.description (summary), articleHeading.authors[].name, and articleText.text.html (full text).
- premium: always false. VRT is a public broadcaster with no paywall field.

Recommended stream catalog:
- net-binnen (latest)
- homepage (top)
- net-binnen/<section> for the 15 themes
- net-binnen/<province> for 7 regions
- most-read and most-viewed-videos
- tag/<x> and dossiers/<x> for topic streams
- liveblogs discovered from net-binnen, then followed via main/list

Not useful or not found:
- /regio/ and /rubrieken/ index pages are personalised or empty shells.
- No dedicated liveblog index exists.
- No pagination on any list except search (search-page/next cursor, 20 per page). Use it for backfill.
- The app BFF variants (x-api-version v6, Token header) and vrtnws-api.vrt.be were not needed and not tested in depth.
- /weather and /traffic are non-news widgets.

All raw fixtures (33 files, vrt-api__*.json) are in /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-williamragnarsson-Documents-Programming-news-wallpaper/0caac9a3-ce23-49a0-8649-ba7ffd1030f7/scratchpad/research/feeds/. Extra probe responses are under /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-williamragnarsson-Documents-Programming-news-wallpaper/0caac9a3-ce23-49a0-8649-ba7ffd1030f7/scratchpad/research/tmp/vrt/.

Prefix duplicates: rubrieken/{section} (11 teasers) is the first 11 of net-binnen/{section}. regio/{province} is the first 11 of net-binnen/{province}. regio/{province}/{municipality} is the first 11 of net-binnen/{province}/{municipality}. headlines/best-of starts with the most-read swimlane, so its first 5 equal most-read. category/best-of for binnenland starts with a 'politiek' swimlane, which is the first 15 of net-binnen/binnenland/politiek. Never offer both members of a pair as separate streams.

Search correction: page-content-search and search-next are ranked by relevance with a recency bias, not newest first. In the first 20 results for 'storm', dates ran 10-25, 10-25, 10-22, 10-25, ..., down to 10-17. The sort, order and sortBy parameters are ignored. Re-sort client-side by metadata[type=time].timestamp if a keyword stream is ever built; it is better suited to backfill.

Liveblog re-test confirms the earlier claims. main/list ignores page, limit, size, offset, from, since, after, before, cursor and count: the response is byte-identical (623469 bytes, 383 posts: 360 regular and 23 highlights). These sub-paths return 404: main/list/next, main/next, main, main/highlights, highlights, summary, main/summary, side/list and bottom/list. If-None-Match with the quoted UUID ETag returns 304 with 0 bytes. Discovery works through net-binnen: 9 liveblog teasers today (1791111887608, 1790599460224, 1787143375321, 1784611610051, 1792507723130, 1789060001669, 1792770744209, 1792663198457 (variant 'end', ended) and 1779777185712). The home page showed only 4 of them; the earlier agent saw 6, so the home count varies over time. page/content for /nl/liveblog/, /liveblogs/ and /live/ returns 404. Because main/list returns the whole blog each time, use ETag polling and diff by post id.

Teaser variant handling: match liveblogs on the variants liveblog-default, liveblog-breaking, live-default, live-breaking and breaking (the last four are known from the site JS), on the variant 'end' for an ended blog, and on the URI pattern /liveblog/...~{id}/. Other variants seen: default, region, video, analysis, author, research, culture, podcast and sporza. Sporza teasers link to sporza.be, so a filter on /vrtnws/ URLs drops them; decide whether to keep them. Skip the trafficTeaser and weatherTeaser compositions on the home page.

Authors: teasers with variant author or culture (reviews and columns) carry the author name in author.image.alt, so author coverage is 'some', not 'none'. For other items, author names are only in article detail (articleHeading.authors[].name). There is no summary on any teaser.
PLAY_VIDEO_GALLERY teasers (vertical videos on /kijk/ and some section lists) have no actions[0].uri. Take the URL from analytics.ebaContexts[].data.targetpageurl and the image from actions[0].image.
The premium flag is always false (confirmed): VRT is a public broadcaster with no paywall field in any response.

Localized editions: the earlier claim '/en/latest/ 404, no English net-binnen found' is superseded. Per-section lists exist at /en/categories/{slug}/, /fr/rubriques/{slug}/ and /de/rubriken/{slug}/ (100 items each), but the index pages and any all-items list return 404. The complete per-language streams are the vrt-nws outlet's Atom feeds (english.xml has 50 entries, plus francais.xml and deutsch.xml); the BFF section lists are slices of them. All English streams use group 'In English'. The fr/de streams use topic groups (News, Politics, World, Regional, Lifestyle), so filter the UI by the language field. fr/rubriques/actu-locale/ is identical to fr/rubriques/belgique/ and was not added.

Checked and not added: en sport, royalty and society-and-you (2 to 3 items in 30 days each); fr sport (5 items in 30 days, newest 10 days old) and de sport (4 items), since Sporza covers sport better; winwin/online-leven (3 items in 30 days, newest 11 days old); winwin/lifehacks (108 days stale); rubrieken/nws-ombudsvrouw (slow, unsorted).
